concept.title: Studio Mode
concept.shortdesc: Preview a scene privately before it goes live or into the recording.

conbody.p: Studio Mode splits the preview into two panes: a private Preview pane on the left where you can select and adjust a scene, and a Program pane on the right showing exactly what's being recorded or streamed. Clicking Transition swaps Preview into Program using the active transition.
This is useful for checking a scene's layout, testing a source, or lining up a graphic before it becomes visible to your audience.
